hypothesis: Seven surviving benchmark-question comparisons give little supervision for deciding when a natural exchange benefits from paired rather than separate written turns. Use actual conversations to generate additional, reader-verified training questions, then measure skill effects on the original physically executed memory paths. Official benchmark questions and independent histories never enter question generation.
population: Take every cross-speaker question/reply found by the frozen reply_probes.exchanges extractor in both sessions of the 12 early four-path windows and in the randomized pivot session only of the 12 donor windows. Preserve all attempts and all exclusions. Order exchanges within a session by a fixed content-independent digest of source coordinates; traverse the first attempt of every session before second attempts. Early background is a seeded fair bit per exchange; donor background is its registered assignment. Training stages are one first attempt per history in session 5 (pilot), first attempt per eligible session (breadth), then every registered attempt (full). No later or independent question is selected by this procedure.
generation: Use cached single-request BF16 Llama on physical GPUs 5/6 at duty 0.28, reserve 4608 MiB per GPU. From the source question and adjacent actual reply only, produce one third-person standalone fact question naming the respondent and a 1–8-word contiguous verbatim reference in that reply. Reject malformed, generic, echoing or unsupported outputs; keep rejected attempts. Independent greedy reader calls with the standard QA prompt must recover the full reference from the two real turns and fail to contain the full reference after replacing the reply by another reply from the same speaker in that session. These are same-model context interventions; they do not constitute independent annotation. Report actual request keys/tokens and exclusions.
physical: Bind archived ordered skill versions, actual writer events and complete pre-action states. On each actual temporal/activity path restore the bank immediately after the pivot. For early pivots additionally measure the final bank after the fixed subsequent skill. Prepare native top-five reads with the frozen Qwen encoder on physical GPU 3 at batch <=2, duty <=0.30, 2 GiB free headroom. Verify one original benchmark control query per physical final bank reproduces its archived ordered memory texts before admitting new retrievals. Benchmark answers do not supply auxiliary rewards. Missing parity makes that trajectory ineligible and is disclosed. Physically ask the standard reader and keep all original requests and responses on the common new backend.
credit: Only a strict whole-reference recovery in an immediate measured arm can give signed span credit. For the weaker action, append missing dated source quotes for the actual question and reply to the same memory and retrieve again; separately replace the last reader slot by an omitted same-skill memory chosen by source overlap. Also measure the weaker context after removing the standalone trailing INSERT block marker and reranking. A competing full-reference recovery vetoes the credit. Veto detected execution faults, registered capped-source defects through the pivot, and root cases without a same-direction strict final recovery. F1 changes without this evidence remain raw returns. Count every registered attempt in coverage and per-session training denominators, including rejects and zero labels.
actor: Average immediate raw effects and surviving signed credit per donor session over all attempted questions in the frozen stage. Within each held-history fold predict from current anonymized source-turn embeddings by the mean of the bidirectional average nearest-turn cosine to each donor session at the same pivot position, using softmax at temperature .05, equal total base mass per training donor history. Add clamp(weighted auxiliary credit/.05,-2,2) to the original repaired benchmark raw-return anchor. Compare auxiliary raw alone and raw plus credit, cyclically reassigned session credits, native, terminal and the raw anchor; main is the isolated verified credit increment. Zero when there is no donor, never train on held-history rewards. Numeric freezes per stage precede scoring on 91 early physical four-path, 88 donor, 40 later windows/378 natural questions, later 40-window four-path replication and the 99 full-prefix endpoints/185 separate cross-window questions. Report simultaneous changes of action propensity, fixed common draws, costs, clustered uncertainty and pre-exposed windows. Require complete full auxiliary stage, >=.02 over native and terminal on the completed later randomized panel, positive joint HT over both, gains over the anchor, auxiliary raw, reassigned and matched-rate controls in aggregate, >=4 winning histories vs matched and positive strict prospective and exact replication gains vs native and raw. Independent development and full LoCoMo/LongMemEval-S tests follow a successful training diagnostic.
reference: Alberti et al., Synthetic QA Corpora Generation with Roundtrip Consistency, ACL 2019. https://aclanthology.org/P19-1620/
